columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Long-horizon recovery must align agent context with environment state at the same checkpoint boundary
columns.title_zh: 长周期 Agent 恢复必须在同一 Checkpoint 边界对齐推理上下文与环境状态
columns.source_zh: AgentRewind / MettleBench 一手研究：同步保存 Agent Context 与受控 Environment State，并从较早的联合 Checkpoint 恢复长周期工程任务
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260913-005 after Skill 02 triage. AgentRewind exposes a bounded long-horizon recovery problem that remains meaningful independent of the paper name: an error may propagate into both the model-visible context and the environment the agent is acting on, so rolling back only one side can resume an internally inconsistent worker. The primary research reports aligned context/environment checkpoints and evaluation across tasks, models, execution strategies and harnesses, giving the object stronger evidence than today's single-implementation engineering signals. The Digital Employee question is which state identities must be bound to one recovery checkpoint, what information from failed attempts may safely survive, and what evidence is required before a resumed worker can act again. This is distinct from the September 4 interrupted-tool replay-safety object, which governed whether an interrupted call could autonomously replay, and from the September 11 memory-evidence object, which preserved atomic observations while semantic memory roles change; today's object concerns coordinated rollback of cognitive and environment/effect state after an error has already propagated through a long-running task.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260913-005。AgentRewind 暴露的是一个不依赖论文名称也成立的长周期恢复问题：错误可能同时污染 Model-visible Context 与 Agent 正在操作的 Environment，因此只回滚其中一侧，会让 Worker 在认知状态与现实状态不一致的情况下继续工作。该一手研究使用对齐的 Context / Environment Checkpoint，并在不同 Task、Model、Execution Strategy 与 Harness 上进行评估，证据强度高于今天几个只有单一实现的工程 Signal。数字员工的有界问题是：一次 Recovery Checkpoint 必须绑定哪些 State Identity，失败尝试中的哪些信息可以安全保留，以及恢复后的 Worker 在再次行动前需要什么证据。它与 9 月 4 日 Interrupted-tool Replay-safety 对象不同，后者研究中断调用是否会被自主重放；也不同于 9 月 11 日 Memory-evidence 对象，后者研究语义 Memory Role 变化时如何保留 Atomic Observation；今天研究的是错误已经在长周期任务中传播后，如何协调回滚认知状态与环境/效果状态。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify AgentRewind's exact checkpoint representation and alignment rule, the controlled-environment assumptions, rollback/resume protocol, what information from failed attempts is retained, MettleBench task and checklist construction, baselines, per-model/per-strategy/per-harness results, ablations and failure cases, and whether any external effect outside the checkpointed environment can remain unknown or irreversible. It must state what the evidence does not prove about exactly-once effects, distributed systems or arbitrary production tools.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 AgentRewind 的精确 Checkpoint 表示与对齐规则、受控 Environment 假设、Rollback / Resume Protocol、失败尝试中保留的信息、MettleBench 的 Task 与 Checklist 构造、Baseline、不同 Model / Strategy / Harness 的结果、Ablation 与失败案例，以及 Checkpoint Environment 之外是否仍可能存在未知或不可逆 External Effect；必须明确这些证据不能证明哪些 Exactly-once Effect、Distributed System 或任意生产 Tool 的结论。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: An agentic audit is not complete when its search finishes; coverage needs separate evidence
columns.title_zh: Agentic Audit 不能因为搜索结束就算完成，Coverage 需要独立证据
columns.source_zh: Anthropic 网络安全事故一手复盘中的 Audit Coverage Failure：较小范围 Agentic Transcript Search 漏掉相关案例，后续发现第 4 起事故后将证据范围扩大到约 4.81 亿条 Transcript
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260913-004 as a strong primary failure result. The bounded architecture problem is completion truth for AI-assisted audits: an agentic search can finish its procedure while failing the business claim that the relevant evidence universe was covered. Anthropic reports that an initial scan of roughly 141,000 transcripts missed relevant cases; after a later review found a fourth incident, the investigation expanded to roughly 481 million transcripts across additional log families. The Industry Architecture question is therefore what observable evidence inventory, coverage metric, blind-spot declaration and independent follow-up process must exist before an audit may be called complete. This reuses a primary source selected on September 10 but does not repeat that research problem: the September 10 object studied high-impact execution authority, scope facts and independent live enforcement when agent and monitor reasoning can share a false premise; today's object isolates audit coverage and the invalid inference from search-process completion to evidence-complete audit. The reused source lowers novelty relative to a wholly new evidence base, but the failure proposition and completion contract are materially distinct.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260913-004，作为强一手 Failure Result。它形成的有界架构问题是 AI-assisted Audit 的 Completion Truth：Agentic Search 可以完成自身搜索程序，却仍然没有满足“相关证据已经被覆盖”的业务命题。Anthropic 报告称，最初约 14.1 万份 Transcript 的扫描漏掉了相关案例；后续复查发现第 4 起事故后，调查范围扩大到约 4.81 亿份 Transcript，并覆盖更多 Log Family。因此，行业架构的问题是：在把 Audit 称为完成之前，必须具备什么可观察的 Evidence Inventory、Coverage Metric、Blind-spot 声明与独立 Follow-up Process。该对象复用了 9 月 10 日已经选过的一手来源，但没有重复当时的研究问题：9 月 10 日研究的是当 Agent 与 Monitor 可能共享错误前提时，高影响执行授权为何需要外部 Scope Fact 与独立 Live Enforcement；今天单独研究 Audit Coverage，以及为什么不能从 Search Process Completed 推导 Evidence-complete Audit。复用来源使 Novelty 低于全新的证据基础，但 Failure Proposition 与 Completion Contract 是实质不同的。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the initial transcript universe and search method, the approximately 141,000-transcript scope, which relevant cases were missed, the later fourth-incident discovery path, the rationale and composition of the roughly 481-million-transcript expansion, whether independent reviewers or different search methods were used, any available false-negative or coverage estimates, and why even the expanded search does not itself prove completeness. It must separate audit-process completion, evidence-universe coverage and final incident attribution.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验初始 Transcript Universe 与 Search Method、约 14.1 万条范围、哪些相关案例被漏掉、后续第 4 起事故的发现路径、扩展到约 4.81 亿条 Transcript 的理由与组成、是否使用独立 Reviewer 或不同 Search Method、可获得的 False-negative / Coverage 估计，以及为什么扩大后的搜索本身仍不能证明 Complete Coverage；必须区分 Audit-process Completion、Evidence-universe Coverage 与最终 Incident Attribution。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260913-002 provides concrete merged implementation evidence for cancellation-time cleanup while preserving cancellation as the authoritative terminal signal, but today it remains one Google ADK implementation without an independent comparison or production failure study. SIG-20260913-003 similarly exposes a useful parallel-state merge contract—concatenate list deltas to avoid silent loss while acknowledging duplicate semantics—but it is also one maintainer implementation and does not yet establish a sufficiently independent comparative object. SIG-20260913-001 is a strong manager/subagent responsibility-boundary candidate, yet it is likewise one Codex implementation. None of these engineering signals clears the preferred evidence-sufficiency threshold strongly enough to displace the two primary-research objects or justify filling a quota, so the column is explicitly closed with No Selection.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260913-002 提供了具体的 Merged Implementation Evidence：取消发生时仍执行 Cleanup，同时把 Cancellation 保持为权威终态信号；但目前只有 Google ADK 一个实现，缺少独立比较或生产 Failure Study。SIG-20260913-003 同样揭示了有价值的 Parallel-state Merge Contract——List Delta 用拼接避免静默丢失，同时明确 Duplicate Semantics 仍未解决——但它也只有单一 Maintainer Implementation，尚不足以形成独立比较对象。SIG-20260913-001 是很强的 Manager / Subagent Responsibility-boundary Candidate，但同样只有 Codex 一个实现。今天这些工程 Signal 都没有以足够强的证据跨过 Skill 02 偏好的 Evidence Sufficiency 门槛，也不应为了填满名额挤掉两个更强的一手研究对象，因此本栏显式以 No Selection 收口。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260913-001, SIG-20260913-002 and SIG-20260913-003 as candidates for future cross-sample studies of human-facing responsibility topology, cancellation/finalization semantics and concurrent state-merge contracts. Reading must perform no separate Open-source Engineering Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260913-001、SIG-20260913-002 与 SIG-20260913-003 为 Candidate，等待未来围绕 Human-facing Responsibility Topology、Cancellation / Finalization Semantics 与 Concurrent State-merge Contract 的跨样本研究；本轮 Reading 不得为 Open-source Engineering 单独执行 Deep Reading。
